title: Pakistan’s footballers show India sportsmanship after SAFF final defeat
html:
Pakistan’s footballers show India sportsmanship after SAFF final defeat

Pakistan’s football team formed a guard of honour for India after losing the SAFF Championship final 2-1 in Bangladesh. The show of sportsmanship contrasts with the hostility and refusal to shake hands often seen between the rivals in cricket.
summary: Pakistan’s football team formed a guard of honour for India after losing the SAFF Championship final 2-1 in Bangladesh.
